scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the confirmed HORT-242 supervised enclosed-bay sanitation practical accessible, including the assigned applicator station, without exceeding the session’s safety boundaries.
Emerging Need: A campus respirator medical clearance is absent; it becomes a prerequisite only when the previously unsettled format resolves into a confirmed tight-fitting-respirator assignment.
Decision Context: The stored conditional record establishes missing status, booking eligibility, privacy limits, and the preferred no-fee route; the active assignment and clinic inventory determine when a valid reservation is possible.
Consequence: A timely clearance visit preserves check-in for the future practical, while expiry of the sole qualifying slot leaves no appointment that can post before roster lock.

parameter.subject: HORT-242 enclosed-bay format still unsettled
parameter.body: Air-handling signoff for the July 30 sanitation practical is still pending. If approved, one student will be assigned the enclosed-bay applicator station, which uses a tight-fitting half-mask respirator; the alternate open-bench format does not. No role assignments or assignment codes have been issued. The final configuration is expected tomorrow.

parameter.title: HORT-242 supervised enclosed-bay sanitation practical
parameter.description: Air-handling signoff is complete. Leona is rostered at the enclosed-bay applicator station under assignment code H242-A17. Check-in requires campus respirator medical clearance to be current in the roster by 2026-07-29 at 17:00 America/New_York. All treatment and respirator-use activity is instructor-supervised.

parameter.content: Cancellation inventory now shows one no-fee horticulture respirator-clearance appointment on 2026-07-27 from 11:30 to 12:00, slot RCL-2711. It can be recorded before the HORT-242 roster lock. A secure-thread reservation is accepted with the slot code and a confirmed assignment code; the slot remains first-come through 2026-07-25 at 13:00. Medical responses are collected privately during the visit.

Slot RCL-2711 left cancellation inventory at 13:00 and is no longer reservable. No remaining campus appointment can be completed and posted by the HORT-242 roster lock on 2026-07-29 at 17:00; the next available clearance visit is 2026-07-31.
